data.narrative:
Wetstone is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector. The comparable universe consists of one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set exhibits limited homogeneity at the seed stage.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable to this analysis. Within the Climate & Energy sector, zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers exist with sufficient density to support a robust median calculation. While eight same-sector companies are available, none pass the narrow filtering criteria required for credible peer triangulation. An all-sector median approach would introduce substantial survivorship and stage bias, rendering results unreliable for a seed-stage capital raise.

Given the sparse, misaligned comparable set, traditional triangulation methods do not yield a defensible valuation range for Wetstone at this stage. The public market reference (LNZA) and later-stage private peers operate in fundamentally different financing and growth contexts than a seed-stage enterprise. Any forward valuation would require either: (1) expansion of the peer universe to adjacent sectors or downstream stages; (2) direct assessment of management, technology differentiation, and market timing; or (3) primary market intelligence on recent Climate & Energy seed rounds. The current data set is insufficient to triangulate a standalone valuation estimate.
